name: Your Company
tagline: Transforming furniture for small flats: one room, three set-ups

seo.title: Your Company — transforming furniture for small apartments
seo.description: Wall beds, folding tables and lift-up sofas for studios and one-bedroom flats. German mechanisms, a demo showroom in Chilanzar and installation in a day.
seo.answer: Your Company is a transforming furniture showroom in Tashkent (Chilanzar, 166 Mukimi Street). Wall beds with German mechanisms from UZS 11,900,000, wall beds with a sofa from UZS 16,500,000, folding tables from UZS 2,400,000. Free measuring and 3D, made in 21 days, installed in one day.

listing.description: A site for transforming furniture, smart-home or tech products: a dot-matrix headline, spec cards with prices, a step-by-step install log and figures on an LED board.

sections.title: Your flat gets bigger
sections.subtitle: Living room by day, bedroom by night and a dining room for eight at weekends. The bed folds into the wardrobe with one hand and the table opens from a console in ten seconds.

sections.label: About us
sections.title: Mechanisms tested for 20,000 lifts
sections.text: Cabinets are made in Tashkent from moisture-resistant E1 board, fitted with German mechanisms and gas struts. Our Chilanzar showroom has a 25 m² studio set up so you can fold the bed yourself and open the table for eight.

sections.label: Models
sections.title: What fits in a single room
sections.intro: Prices are for the base size and colour; the exact price comes after measuring.

items.title: Vertical wall bed
items.text: Sleeps 160×200 · gas struts · orthopaedic slats · 45 cm deep

items.title: Wall bed with sofa
items.text: Bed 140×200 · sofa stays in place · side shelves

items.title: Console table
items.text: 45 cm folded · up to 230 cm open · seats up to 8

items.title: Office in a cupboard
items.text: Fold-down desk · sockets and lighting · closes with the monitor inside

items.title: Measuring
items.text: A surveyor visits with samples and checks the wall and wiring. Free.

items.title: 3D design
items.text: We show the room in three set-ups: day, night and guests.

items.title: Production
items.text: 21 working days, with photos from the assembly line.

items.title: Installation
items.text: Anchored to the wall, mechanism adjusted, rubbish removed — all in one day.

items.title: Service
items.text: After six months we retune the mechanism for free.

items.quote: In 28 square metres we now have both a bedroom and somewhere to host guests.
items.author: Dilshod

items.quote: My daughter folds the bed away herself in the morning — the mechanism is light.
items.author: Saida
